transformed_hypotheses.changed_mechanism: Treat execution epoch + provenance + recovery state as a cross-layer causal spine that is revalidated at every consequential boundary (state write, response emit, effect reserve/start, replay/reentry), not as a presence-only field.
transformed_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Physical exclusion plus local subsystem checks are sufficient and cross-layer fencing only harms liveness.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Composed current-main crash/takeover/replay/effect matrix passes without shared epoch propagation or shows equivalent safety with materially simpler mechanism.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: PR158-style composed execution/recovery/effect test extended through UnifiedDB replay and response emission, then inverted after the minimal repair.

transformed_hypotheses.changed_mechanism: Unify memory reactivation and adaptive recurrence as selective state intervention: intervene only when a provenance-bound state item is predicted to change the next decision or reduce unresolved pressure; otherwise emit null intervention.
transformed_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Passive retrieval plus ordinary GWT attention is sufficient; explicit intervention policy adds cost and wrong reminders.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Equal-budget passive retrieval matches selective intervention on long-horizon success, forgotten constraints, repeated errors, latency and token cost.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Frozen long-horizon episodes with three arms: bounded passive retrieval, always-on memory, selective intervention with null option; record next-action causal-use receipts.

transformed_hypotheses.changed_mechanism: Retain structural untrusted-data separation but extend the security model from payload class to contextual flow: sender/recipient/purpose/data-class/integrity provenance must remain explicit inputs to deterministic effect policy.
transformed_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Simple trusted/untrusted taint plus capability checks already covers the meaningful attack surface.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Context-manipulation attacks do not increase forbidden-flow rate over ordinary instruction-like attacks, or richer contextual labels cause unacceptable benign denial without security gain.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Adversarial norm/recipient/purpose substitution matrix across web, tool-result and direct-token channels with fixed effects and benign controls.

transformed_hypotheses.changed_mechanism: Evaluate GWT/recurrent continuation as an adaptive compute policy driven by unresolved pressure and expected marginal verified outcome gain, not as a claim that recurrence itself is emergence or intelligence.
transformed_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Fixed-depth or event-driven execution is Pareto-superior once compute is equalized.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Adaptive recurrence fails to beat matched fixed/event baselines on hard/easy stratified outcomes after latency/token/recovery cost.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Three-arm matched replay with equal maximum compute, randomized arm order, lesions of GWT ignition and historical regulators, and hard/easy task strata.

transformed_hypotheses.changed_mechanism: ClayCode earns architectural authority only where it measurably prevents semantic duplication/drift or enables cross-layer machine-checkable invariants better than a simpler typed host-language/IDL baseline.
transformed_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Conventional typed code plus schema/version/provenance checks is sufficient and cheaper.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Simpler baseline matches invalid-flow rejection, replay equivalence and change safety with lower complexity/resource cost.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Implement the same presence-bound effect receipt and identity-replay invariant in ClayCode and a minimal typed baseline, then mutation-test both.

transformed_hypotheses.changed_mechanism: Hyperposition is reduced to a testable alternative-management mechanism and must beat beam/top-k/reseed baselines before any higher-order topology becomes required v0.1 architecture.
transformed_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Generic diversity preservation is the whole benefit.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Beam/top-k/reseed matches stagnation escape and OOD recovery at lower complexity/cost.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Matched stalled-episode factorial with equal alternative count and memory budget.

architecture_delta_summary: Prioritize cross-layer execution fencing and selective state intervention; strengthen contextual information-flow testing; keep adaptive recurrence bounded by compute baselines; impose simpler-baseline gates on ClayCode, typed reward and Hyperposition.
